column2: Shoves ahead, hitting and slowing enemies.
Smashes down on one foe with all your strength.
Leaps up and slams down on an enemy.
A single long-range shot that pierces hard.
A widely curving arrow that pierces enemies in a line.
A pillar of fire erupts beneath an enemy.
Lays a sea of fire that burns the ground for a long time.
Scatters embers in a short range.
An ice spear pierces in a straight line.
Launches an orb that bursts and freezes the area.
Wraps you in ice to raise defense.
Freezes the area ahead with cold wind.
A small bolt jumps between two enemies.
A thundercloud strikes a wide area.
Surrounds you with a small shield.
Strikes with an arrow of light.
Blesses the ground beneath you, burning nearby enemies.
Surrounds you with a thick barrier of light.
Calms your mind to raise critical chance.
Roars to pull in nearby enemies and briefly reduce damage taken.
Grits your teeth and holds on.
Returns part of the damage taken to the attacker.
Stores damage taken for {} seconds, then releases it around you.
Charges at an enemy with your shield raised. Stronger with higher defense.
Rolls the ground to shake the area.
Grits your teeth to briefly reduce damage taken.
Rolls backward to gain distance and briefly raise dodge.
Freezes nearby enemies, briefly immobilizing them.
Hides in smoke, briefly raising dodge greatly.
Coats your weapon in poison to raise damage.
Slips beside an enemy like a shadow.
Cleaves ahead with a freezing blade.
Sweeps ahead with a wave of light.
Rams with your body and slashes.
Splits the ground to shake the area.
A single shot threaded through the stars.
Arrows pour down riding the wind.
Fires as heavily as you've endured.
Hardens mana into a protective shield.
Releases the power of Spirit around you.
Heats your body with a spell to raise damage.
Hardens body and mind to wrap you in a large shield.
Targets your prey to raise critical hits.
Bashes with your shield. Stronger the more Max {} you've added from gear (also uses a little {}).
Pushes ahead with a sturdy body. Stronger with higher defense.
Smashes the ground to shake the area. Stronger the more Max {} you've added from gear (also uses {}).
Smashes down with all your weight. Stronger with higher defense.
Blocks damage with {1} instead of {0} (uses less {2} as rank rises).
Fires a mass of mana. Stronger the more Max {} you've added from gear.
Bursts mana from your body. Stronger the more Max {} you've added from gear.
Unleashes overflowing mana in a line.
Calls down a rain of mana four times.
